announcements.t: Hitech Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of In-principle approval from both the stock exchanges as per Regulation 21 of SEBI Delisting Regulations. |SUBJECT: General Updates

Hitech Corporation Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on September 24, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results. |SUBJECT: Shareholders meeting
